about_short_description.short_description: Tailor is a no-code headless ERP platform helping retail businesses unify tools, marketplaces, and teams on one system.

product.name: Tailor Headless Composable ERP
product.description: A modular, API-first ERP for retail, ecommerce, omnichannel, B2B, DTC, and manufacturing operations. It unifies orders, inventory, procurement, production, warehousing, and cost accounting.

product.name: Tailor Platform
product.description: A low-code, developer-oriented platform for creating customizable headless business applications, APIs, data models, workflows, and integrations without building backend infrastructure from scratch.

product.name: Inventory Management
product.description: A retail inventory management module for real-time stock visibility, inventory costing, demand forecasting, replenishment, and stock movement across channels and locations.

product.name: Omnichannel Order Management
product.description: A centralized order management module for coordinating ecommerce, marketplace, POS, in-store, wholesale, and B2B orders with configurable fulfillment, pricing, returns, and routing workflows.

product.name: Purchase Management
product.description: A procurement module for supplier management, purchase order creation, demand-based replenishment, shipment and invoice matching, and purchasing workflow automation.

product.name: Production Management
product.description: A manufacturing operations module for make-to-stock, make-to-order, job shop, and batch production, including bills of materials, work orders, resource planning, costing, and quality workflows.
